summary: Tested Arabic HR Management App (TANSEEQ) - Custom Report feature, Edit/Delete buttons, and deployment fix. All backend tests passed (10/10). Frontend shows the features are implemented but a UX issue with persistent notification modal blocks testing of Custom Report modal UI interaction.

ui_bugs.issue: Notification modal keeps appearing on every page navigation and blocks UI interaction with other elements. The modal shows 19 unread notifications and persists even after attempting to dismiss. Users cannot easily access Custom Report modal because notification modal intercepts clicks.

action_items: Consider adding a 'Don't show again' option to the notification modal or reduce its frequency
Ensure notification modal can be properly dismissed before showing Custom Report modal
Add data-testid to the notification modal dismiss buttons for easier automated testing
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ attendance_engine.py has proper try/except around createIndex (lines 41-77) - Deployment fix verified
✅ Custom Report modal JSX exists in App.js (lines 5227-5324) with proper data-testids
✅ Edit button shows for super_admin (line 4705 check: user?.role === 'super_admin')
✅ Delete button shows for super_admin (line 4734 nested check)
✅ Backend /api/attendance/custom-report endpoint works correctly (tested with pytest)
⚠️ Notification modal UX blocks other modals - checkMandatoryNotifications runs on every page load
seed_data_creation: None created - used existing attendance records (157+) and users (14)
context_for_next_testing_agent: The notification modal appears after login and on every page navigation. To properly test UI elements behind it, you may need to: 1) Mark all notifications as read first via API, or 2) Add a way to disable the auto-notification check. The modal shows 19+ unread notifications that block clicks on other UI elements. Backend APIs are all working correctly - focus testing on the notification modal dismissal flow.

deployment_fix_mongodb_createindex.description: try/except block wraps all createIndex calls with graceful error handling

custom_report_modal.backend_endpoint: POST /api/attendance/custom-report - Returns 200 with file_content or 404 if no records
custom_report_modal.frontend_modal: JSX exists at App.js lines 5227-5324 with data-testids
custom_report_modal.blocker: Notification modal intercepts clicks preventing modal from opening

edit_delete_buttons_super_admin.description: Edit/Delete buttons visible in attendance table for super_admin users - confirmed in screenshots
